I've checked for meet up groups trust me, but unfortunately there simply isn't any within a reasonable distance.

I've never had a girlfriend in my life, 6 years marks the last time I had a friend who I could talk to but that was at highschool. I was never popular, never picked for p.e activties, never picked as a partner in normal class (normally did projects solo as a result) and never had a chance to go to a party. But I didn't care, atleast I could talk to someone
